cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: The Lord will send out the scepter of your power from Zion.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession with твоей.

cases.sentence: В тот день твой народ добровольно пойдет за тобой на ___.
cases.translation: Your people will volunteer freely on the day you go to battle.
cases.explain: The preposition на (to) with accusative indicates destination.

cases.sentence: Твоя ___ будет обновляться каждый день, как утренняя роса.
cases.translation: Your power will be renewed day by day like the morning dew.
cases.explain: Сила is the subject of будет, so it takes nominative case.

cases.translation: You are a priest forever according to the order.
cases.explain: The genitive case indicates the order being referenced.

cases.sentence: Он сразит царей в день своего ___.
cases.translation: He will strike down kings in the day of his anger.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession with своего.

cases.sentence: Будет судить ___ и покроет поле боя их трупами.
cases.explain: Direct object of судить takes accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он будет на пути пить из ___.
cases.translation: He will drink from the brook beside the road.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.
